Yes, I'm in Santa Maria del Tule, just outside of Oaxaca.  Southern mexico is near Belize.

And yes, the food is probably safer here than back home now.

Except for the street taco vendors, most are good.
Once in a while, you get a bad taco that will make you a little sick.
